## Activity

River Outreach recorded 45 captures during July 2022. This activity provides the basis for the site’s review of image quality and grading performance. The overall capture volume should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting so that any changes in activity can be identified and followed up appropriately.

## Image quality

Of the 45 captures, 4 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.9. This result should be considered alongside the recurring camera issues reported by the clinic lead. Staff are asked to log these issues with the service desk so that equipment concerns can be recorded and addressed through the appropriate support process.

## Grading

There were 5 referable results. The median lag was 0, indicating no median delay in the reported grading measure. The site should continue to review grading outcomes and maintain the existing process for escalating operational or equipment issues. Recording camera problems consistently will support ongoing monitoring of image quality and help inform service follow-up at River Outreach.
